usage: The word '牛肉麵' (ngau4 juk6 min6) refers to a type of noodle dish with beef, and it is used as a noun.
'牛肉麵' can be the subject or object in a sentence, e.g. '我想食牛肉麵' (I want to eat beef noodles).
You can use adjectives before '牛肉麵' to describe it, such as '好食牛肉麵' (delicious beef noodles).
'牛肉麵' can be combined with quantity words to express amount, for example, '一碗牛肉麵' (a bowl of beef noodles).
